targets.label: Persistence of sentiment, SENT⊥ (quarterly AR(1))
targets.note: Candidate for the persistence of κ. The index is built from twelve-month sums and lagged values, which raise persistence; its scale is standardised, so it says nothing about the size of κ shocks.

targets.label: Equity share of new issues, mean
targets.note: Equity over equity plus debt issues, past twelve months; 11.4 percent since 1990.

targets.label: Gross equity issues / market value: cash raised by all issuers, mean
targets.note: Cash raised by new share issues in a quarter relative to the market value of nonfinancial corporate equities at the start of the quarter. Most of it is raised by seasoned offerings of listed firms, so it is not the value of entrants: the target for κ is in the table on the value of entrants (IPOs and the value of entrants, above). The Bulletin series covers all corporations, the market value nonfinancial corporations only.

targets.label: Net equity issuance / market value, mean
targets.note: Issues minus buybacks and shares retired in mergers; -0.26 percent per quarter since 1990.

targets.label: First-day return of IPOs, mean
targets.note: Underpricing of new issues: entrants sell below the price at which their shares then trade.

entry_value.label: IPOs / all nonfinancial corporate equities (Z.1)
entry_value.formula: market value of the year’s IPOs at the first close / Z.1 market value at the end of the previous year; per quarter 1 − (1 − x)^(1/4), year by year
entry_value.note: The Z.1 market value includes closely held corporations, which do not list: a broad denominator.

entry_value.label: IPOs / public corporate equities (Z.1)
entry_value.formula: as above, over Z.1 public corporate equities
entry_value.note: Public corporations only from 1996 Q4; before, the series still includes closely held corporations.

entry_value.label: IPOs / listed domestic companies (WFE)
entry_value.formula: as above, over the market capitalisation of listed domestic companies at the end of the previous year
entry_value.note: Listed firms only, the universe IPOs enter; includes financial companies.

entry_value.label: IPOs at the offer price / all nonfinancial corporate equities (Z.1)
entry_value.formula: first-close value / (1 + proceeds-weighted first-day return), over the Z.1 market value
entry_value.note: A lower bound: the value at which entrants sell. With the equal-weighted mean first-day return instead: 0.28752 percent per quarter.

entry_value.label: IPO proceeds / gross equity issues
entry_value.formula: sum of IPO proceeds / sum of gross equity issues (Federal Reserve Bulletin) over the years
entry_value.note: Mean of the annual ratios: 21.7 percent. Most of the cash raised by share issues comes from seasoned offerings of firms already listed, so gross issues over market value is not the value of entrants.
